# Puppet Forge modules

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/puppet.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Puppet 8.10.0 on Ruby 3.4.11**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/puppet/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- Valid Forge module archives and dependency versions available through the repository.

Authentication: Supply an access/reference token using --forge_authorization "Bearer $AW_TOKEN". The token subject requires read permission for the root module and dependencies; publication requires deploy permission. Keep token arguments out of shared process logs.

Fresh client state: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.

## Configure

Use a fresh modules directory and vardir for each installation.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/modules" "$AW_WORK/var" "$AW_WORK/conf"
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

Upload valid Puppet module archives with metadata.json; publish dependencies as well as the root module.

```sh
curl --fail --silent --show-error --header "Authorization: Bearer $AW_TOKEN" --upload-file acme-helper-1.0.0.tar.gz "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/acme-helper/acme-helper-1.0.0.tar.gz"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --header "Authorization: Bearer $AW_TOKEN" --upload-file acme-widget-1.0.0.tar.gz "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/acme-widget/acme-widget-1.0.0.tar.gz"
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

The native client resolves and installs module dependencies through the same Forge endpoint.

```sh
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" puppet module install acme-widget --module_repository "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/puppet/$AW_REPO" --target-dir "$AW_WORK/modules" --modulepath "$AW_WORK/modules" --vardir "$AW_WORK/var" --confdir "$AW_WORK/conf" --forge_authorization "Bearer $AW_TOKEN"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- This pins the public Puppet client; commercial Puppet Core versions are not claimed.
- The public Puppet client uses the supported Ruby 3.3 line because its dependency resolution failed on the attempted Ruby 4 base. The client inventory records the current patch.
